analysis.reasonEn: The previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see stance. Today, RSI remains at 52.1 in neutral territory, and MACD histogram improvement has slowed. ADX is at 10.1, indicating no trend formation, with volatility (ATR) at a high 4.55%. Volume ratio to the 5-day average is 1.11, a normal level. The current price of 109,500 KRW is at 59.7% of its 52-week range, in a neutral zone. The price is consolidating between the swing resistance of 110,910 KRW and swing support of 100,000 KRW. While the weekly ADX at 29.6 suggests a clear trend, the daily chart lacks directional conviction. Due to the absence of multi-timeframe alignment and low ADX strength, a wait-and-see approach is maintained.
